summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship Phase 64 (Rotation Soundness — Revocation Guarantees) for CipherBox, covering five bugs in the key-rotation engine (D-01 through D-07), four seam fills, and an sdk-e2e crash-safety gate.
summary.outcome: All 8 plans across 6 waves were fully executed with TDD throughout; the ship-phase pipeline ran through verify (passed), secure (SECURED), and simplify (stale-comment cleanup) before the transcript ends mid-commit — the PR had not yet been opened.

repo: Test files are excluded from tsconfig.build.json, so type errors in *.test.ts files are invisible to CI; only explicit `tsc --noEmit` (not tsup/vitest) catches them.
tsup (esbuild) does not type-check during build — it only bundles. Always run `tsc --noEmit` separately to surface real type errors.
vi.clearAllMocks() does NOT drain mockResolvedValueOnce queues; leftover Once values contaminate subsequent tests. Use vi.resetAllMocks() in beforeEach when using Once mocks.
The GSD commit helper reliably reports `commit_failed` as a false-negative — always verify with `git log --oneline -1`, never blindly retry.

Running a background git commit while a subagent also commits causes lint-staged to stash-pop into conflict, surfacing STATE.md merge markers and unrelated stash garbage as untracked files. Never overlap background git operations.

The design's crash-recovery model (§4.5) is double-rotation, not no-double-bump: 'an extra rotation only strengthens revocation.' A success criterion in the ROADMAP that said 'without double-bumping' directly contradicted the design.

mergeChildren uses remote-wins policy, which can downgrade an already-rotated child's readKeySealed on a CAS-409 re-merge (the concurrent add survives but the child becomes un-navigable). Local-wins for known-rotated refs is the correct policy.
The PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY remaining in sealNode write-body calls (role 0x04) is legitimate Phase-65 scope — it is NOT the D-01 fail-closed bug, which applies only to the IPNS publish key.

verifySubtreeClean is only invoked when completedNodeIds is non-empty; a genuine fresh-record resume (empty set) bypasses it and hits AEAD failure on the already-rotated root. True mid-walk crash recovery requires the Phase-68 durable floor.

code.finding: D-02 bug: sealChildReadKey was called with the child's own pre-rotation key (misnomer `parentReadKey`) instead of the parent's new readKey'. Fixed in 64-04 to re-seal out-of-band in the BFS caller under the parent's NEW readKey'.
D-01 fail-closed guard: throws if nodeIpnsPrivateKey is absent before publish. The PLACEHOLDER_WRITE_KEY at L394 (write-body seal role 0x04) is a separate, intentional Phase-65 deferral.
D-07 ordering bug: completedNodeIds.add fired before reMintGrantsRootedAt (L391). Must be swapped so a crash between them doesn't mark a node complete without re-minting grants.
D-07 resume guard short-circuited the walk without calling verifySubtreeClean, allowing a previously-complete node to be reported done without confirming subtree convergence.
Correct ordering after D-07 fix: reMintGrantsRootedAt (L600) must complete before completedNodeIds.add (L611), with the catch at L621 rethrowing before L611 so crashes don't mark nodes done.
verifySubtreeClean is only called when completedNodeIds is non-empty; a fresh-record resume (empty set) never enters the verification path, causing AEAD failure at the already-rotated root.

D-02 fix location: the out-of-band parent re-seal is in the BFS caller (rotateReadFromNode), not in rotateOne. sealChildReadKey(result.childReadKey, parentState.parentNewReadKey, ...) writes back to the parent's SealedChildRef.

Convergence guard: currentPub.generation > item.enqueuedGeneration skips rotateOne for frontier children. This only covers children with a parent mirror; the root has no parent mirror so it can never be skipped — requiring the Phase-68 durable floor for mid-walk resume.

D-06 bug: id: params.nodeId ?? crypto.randomUUID() and generation: params.nodeGeneration ?? 0 silently broke AAD stability on every updateFolderMetadataAndPublish call site that omitted these fields. Fixed to require them as non-optional.

@ts-expect-error directive was placed above `await expect(` rather than directly above the erroring multi-line call, causing it to be 'unused' while the real TS2345 fired below. Directives must sit on the line immediately preceding the error.

CryptoError was imported from @cipherbox/core (wrong) instead of @cipherbox/crypto (correct). The test passed at runtime only because toThrow(undefined) matches any throw — the wrong import was masked until tsc --noEmit ran.

workflow: Never run background git commits concurrently with subagent commits — lint-staged's stash/pop mechanism produces merge conflicts and surfaces untracked garbage from old stashes.
TypeScript incremental build artifacts (.tsbuildinfo) are left untracked between executor runs and must be cleaned manually to avoid accidental commits by subsequent executors.

The GSD plan-checker enforces two doc-level gates: RESEARCH.md Open Questions must be marked (RESOLVED) and VALIDATION.md must have a concrete per-task map (not TBD placeholders) before execution can proceed.
When a ROADMAP success criterion contradicts the design document, the design document wins — update the SC rather than implementing an over-constrained guard that silently weakens the test.

sdk-e2e tests can silently weaken their assertions to pass when the underlying mechanism isn't fully implemented; always scrutinize documented deviations in SUMMARY files rather than accepting a green suite at face value.
Pre-execution: confirm the API dev server is up and healthy before dispatching the sdk-e2e wave — docker-compose healthy alone is not sufficient.
The GSD false-negative commit pattern: lint-staged runs markdownlint + prettier successfully, the commit lands, but the gsd-tools wrapper returns commit_failed. git log is authoritative.

friction: lint-staged stash-pop conflict: running a background commit while a subagent also committed caused STATE.md to enter merge-conflict state and surfaced untracked directories from an old phase-3 stash as apparent working-tree noise.

tsup builds mask type errors entirely — two categories of phase-64-introduced test type errors (misplaced @ts-expect-error, wrong CryptoError import source) were invisible until an explicit tsc --noEmit was added to the executor prompt mid-phase.
vi.clearAllMocks() contaminated D-02/D-09 tests via leftover mockResolvedValueOnce queues from a failed RED test run; required switching to vi.resetAllMocks() as a Rule 1 deviation.
Plan-checker first pass returned 1 blocker + 2 warnings, requiring a planner revision loop (SendMessage to resume the planner agent) and a second checker run before proceeding to execution.

ROADMAP SC#4 ('without double-bumping') directly contradicted design §4.5 ('double-rotation only strengthens revocation'), which wasn't caught until the sdk-e2e executor hit the corner case and reported it as a deviation.
The GSD commit-helper false-negative fires consistently and requires a separate git log verification step every time — adds cognitive overhead across many commits.
API-surface regen produced 0 symbols (stale/empty tool), providing no value for this phase and creating a misleading artifact.
open_items: CAS-409 merge remote-wins downgrades rotated child's readKeySealed on concurrent-add: fix is local-wins for known-rotated child refs during merge. Todo: .planning/todos/pending/2026-06-29-rotation-concurrent-add-merge-downgrades-rotated-child-readkey.md, targeting Phase 68.

Fresh-record resume (empty completedNodeIds) is not viable mid-walk — requires Phase-68 durable client floor (IndexedDB) to persist readKeyPrime across crash. SC#4's 'without double-bumping' wording should be corrected in the ROADMAP to match §4.5 design intent. Todo: rotation-fresh-record-resume-and-sc4-double-bump.md.
contentRekeyPending marker and lazy file re-encryption wiring deferred to Phase 65 (node/v3 schema frozen this phase).
Live shares API grant wiring (updateGrantFn/deleteGrantFn connected to real persistence) deferred to Phase 66 (schema cutover).

rootReadKey is never zeroed after use in rotateReadFromNode — only readKeyPrime and item.nodeReadKey are explicitly zeroed. The security audit classified this as T-64-06f mitigated but the rootReadKey gap was noted.
Pre-existing test type errors: 12 errors in cas.test.ts (from Phase prior) and 11 in grant.test.ts (Phase 63) are invisible to CI because test files are excluded from tsconfig.build.json.
